designNotes: The pagehide wiring lives in EquipmentRegistry.initialize(), NOT in src/pages/_app.tsx, which is unchanged. All six initialize() sites (listed above) inherit the protection with no signature change and no per-callsite plumbing.

Abort classification as implemented: aborted := signal?.aborted === true OR error.name === 'AbortError'. The ambiguous 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' is a cancellation ONLY while the signal we passed is already aborted; with a live signal or no signal it stays a genuine failure. Pinned by two tests using the identical rejection object on both sides of the boundary. The reviewer noted (axis1, severity note) that once the signal IS aborted every rejection in the try block becomes the sentinel, including a SyntaxError from a malformed file - deliberate: 'interrupted' is a WINDOW classification, not a per-error one.

The sentinel lives in equipmentLoadAbort.ts, not EquipmentFileReader.ts. The first attempt co-located it in the reader and broke 9 tests across 3 shipped suites (EquipmentLoaderService.schemaBridge, EquipmentMapping.canonical, useEquipmentCalculations) because each jest.mock's the reader with a readJsonFile-only factory, erasing the new named exports. Relocating restored all 9 without editing a shipped test.
On the first aborted read the loader returns immediately - once the signal is aborted every remaining read is doomed, so ~29 further fetches are skipped (asserted: fetch called exactly twice).
success is false for an interrupted load; errors is empty, so the pre-existing errors.length === 0 rule alone would have reported success and marked a partial corpus loaded.
